entries.zh: 尽管在战斗中被击败，大可汗仍聚集起另一只舰队，如今甚至正在回归前线。
entries.en: After having met with defeat in battle, the Great Khan has marshaled yet another fleet and is even now returning to the front lines.
[marauder_mercenary_country.GetSpeciesName] mercenaries are now available for hire.

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!的考古学家们已经设法推断出§H沃陶姆§!母星系的秘密坐标！
entries.en: Archeologists from the §H[From.GetName]§! have managed to deduce the secret location of the §HVultaum§! home system!

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!的考古学家们已经设法推断出§H尤特§!母星系的秘密坐标！
entries.en: Archeologists from the §H[From.GetName]§! have managed to deduce the secret location of the §HYuht§! home system!

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!的考古学家们已经设法推断出§H第一联盟§!母星系的秘密坐标！
entries.en: Archeologists from the §H[From.GetName]§! have managed to deduce the secret location of the §HFirst League§! home system!

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!的考古学家们已经设法推断出§H伊拉斯人§!母星系的秘密坐标！
entries.en: Archeologists from the §H[From.GetName]§! have managed to deduce the secret location of the §HIrassian§! home system!

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!的考古学家们已经设法推断出§H赛博勒克斯§!母星系的秘密坐标！
entries.en: Archeologists from the §H[From.GetName]§! have managed to deduce the secret location of the §HCybrex§! home system!

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!已经收集齐所有解锁§HL-星门网络§!的必要认知！一旦他们研究了L-星门科技并完成一项特殊任务来开启他们境内的L-星门，他们将可抵达L-星团。
entries.en: The §H[From.GetName]§! has gathered all the insights necessary to unlock the §HL-Gate Network§!! Once they have researched the L-Gate technology and finished a special project to open an L-Gate within their borders, they will have access to the L-Cluster.

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!已经设法恢复了通往L-星团的道路！被称为§H$nanite_space_dragon_baby_plural$§!的巨大生物从每个现有的L-星门中出现，但他们似乎未展示出敌意。
entries.en: The §H[From.GetName]§! has managed to restore access to the L-Cluster! Giant creatures known as §H$nanite_space_dragon_baby_plural$§! are emerging from every existing L-Gate, although they do not yet appear to be hostile.

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!已经成功开启了L-星团，却意外地发现它已经被一个名叫§H德萨努协和国§!的高等文明占据了！
entries.en: The §H[From.GetName]§! have successfully unlocked the L-Cluster, only to reveal that it is already inhabited by an advanced civilization known as the §HDessanu Consonance§!!

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!那群粗心的傻瓜企图玩弄超越他们理解的力量，结果在§H[shroud_spawn_system.GetName]§!恒星系释放了一个强大而报复性的虚境化身！
entries.en: The careless fools of the §H[From.GetName]§! have meddled with forces beyond their understanding, unleashing a powerful and vengeful Shroud Avatar in the §H[shroud_spawn_system.GetName]§! system!

entries.zh: §H[From.Owner.GetName]§!的科学官们接收到了一个神秘的信号，它似乎是从一个黑洞中心发射出来……
entries.en: Scientists from the §H[From.Owner.GetName]§! have picked up a mysterious signal that appears to emanate from the center of a black hole...

entries.zh: 时之螶已经把§H[From.Owner.GetName]§!的母星系变得……不一样了。
entries.en: The Worm-in-Waiting has remade the home system of the §H[From.Owner.GetName]§! into something... different.

entries.zh: 时之螶已经将自己具现化在§H[From.Owner.GetName]§!的家园星系。战斗开始了……
entries.en: The Worm-in-Waiting has manifested itself in the home system of the §H[From.Owner.GetName]§!. Battle is joined...
